_doc: Per-platform posting config for the local poster agent (see specs/specs.md: Local publish 1-3/3). Keys match config/ad-platforms.json. Only enabled platforms get Publish buttons; the rest stay manual. login_url is where the agent opens a headed browser on the operator's machine when a session is missing/stale; new_listing_url is where the posting script starts the listing form. login_success tells the agent's login detection (workers/posting/capture/detect.ts) when the operator has finished logging in: cookie = a cookie name that appears on success, redirect_off = a path the browser leaves on success. URLs for disabled platforms are best-effort placeholders — verify against the live site before enabling. Sessions live ONLY on the operator's machine at workers/posting/auth/<platform>.json (secrets — never expose via the files API or logs). land_com MUST gain a positive cookie signal: its redirect_off-only login_success false-positived on the Akamai Access Denied flow (see the Land.com access spike entry in specs/specs.md). The agent logs the session's cookie NAMES (never values) on every successful login capture — after the first real login on the operator's machine, take land_com's session-cookie name from that log line and add it here as login_success.cookie alongside redirect_off. When both cookie and redirect_off are set, detection requires BOTH (AND) — unit-tested in workers/posting/capture/detect.test.ts.

land_century._doc: Next.js SPA. There is no login page: logged-out visits to /admin bounce to the home page, where the account icon (top right) opens the Sign In modal. The session is the apiToken key in localStorage (plus the site's cookies); the create form (form.properties-admin-form) renders only when logged in. Mapped 2026-10-05 from the site's front-end source; see post-land_century.ts.

landflip._doc: Seller area is MY LANDFLIP at my.landflip.com (jQuery/Foundation, server-rendered; ajax actions on /json/listings). The public www.landflip.com sits behind Cloudflare and refuses headless browsers, so the poster never opens it (public URL is built as https://www.landflip.com/land/<id>). Sign-in lives under /sign-in; every logged-in page carries the sidebar Sign Out link. Title field is 35 chars (letters, digits, space - , . + / & $ ' only). Entry plan: 1 listing, 10 photos. Mapped 2026-10-12; see post-landflip.ts.

land_listings._doc: Laravel site. Plain POST login at /login (#email, #password); the account home is /dashboard and Sell Land goes to /add-a-listing (both bounce to /login when logged out; a logged-in visit to /login bounces away again). The dashboard sidebar (#dashboard-menu) and the POST logout form exist only when logged in. Publishing needs a paid membership (Premium Standard $49.95/mo or Deluxe $149.95/mo); a Free Account can only save Unlisted listings with one photo. Mapped 2026-10-05 from the public site and its API docs; the logged-in form is still to be confirmed, see post-land_listings.ts.

landhub._doc: Post by hand. The sign-in at /auth/signin is guarded by an invisible Google reCAPTCHA that fails for an automated browser (next-auth answers /api/auth/error?error=Google%20ReCaptcha%20Failure, seen 2026-10-13), and we do not build around that or import a browser session to skip it. The member area is a Next.js app under /user/ (dashboard, add-property wizard starting at /user/add-property/basic-details, properties); photos go through img.landhub.com. Account: Partner plan ($89/mo, 50 listings). The site advertises automated listing uploads for members (feed partners such as RealStack and Land Broker MLS); if Landhub accepts a listing feed from us, that is the sanctioned automation route.
manual_steps: Sign in at landhub.com in your normal browser, then open the add-property wizard (link below). Fill the basic details from the title, price and description here.
Work through the wizard's later steps (location, photos, pricing); upload the photos in the order shown below, first one as the cover.
Publish, open the live listing, copy its URL from the address bar, and record it below.

facebook_marketplace._doc: No poster on purpose: Marketplace has no listing API for an individual seller, Meta's terms forbid automated posting, and a Playwright session on the operator's own account risks a Marketplace ban or account checkpoint. The dashboard shows a post-by-hand card (ManualPublishCard) with the generated copy, the photos in order, the create-form link, and a box to record the live URL as a posting. Listing form seen 2026-10-12: Item for sale, 10 photos + 1 video, title, price, category (use Other), condition, description, More details, location (defaults to the account's city; set it to the property's town). Title cap 100 chars is from seller guides, not Meta; description cap unknown.
manual_steps: Open the create form (Item for sale). Drag the photos below onto it in order; the first one is the cover.
Paste the title and the price (digits only). Category: Other. Condition: pick any; it is required for items.
Paste the description.
Change the location from your home town to the property's town so local buyers see it, then Next and Publish.
Open the published listing, copy its URL from the address bar, and record it below.
facebook_marketplace.paid_promotion: Do not use the Marketplace Boost button on a land listing: the boost is reviewed as an ad, cannot declare a Special Ad Category, and the 2026-10-12 boost of item 1549144040235349 was rejected under Discriminatory Practices (financial products and services) because of the financing terms. To pay for reach, create a Page ad in Ads Manager that links to the listing, declare the Housing special ad category, and paste the BOOST HEADLINE / BOOST DESCRIPTION sections from facebook_marketplace.md (cash price only, no financing words). Rejections and reviews are tracked at https://www.facebook.com/business-support-home/ (Account Overview, View assets).

ebay_item._doc: Post-by-hand entry for the item ad builder (BuyWander lots and other goods). No eBay poster exists; the key `ebay` belongs to land ads (long-form listing HTML from knowledge-base/ebay). The worker writes <workspace>/ebay_item.md with HEADLINE (80 max), ITEM SPECIFICS and DESCRIPTION sections; ManualPublishCard shows the copy, the photos in order (24 max on a standard listing) and records the live URL.
manual_steps: Open the sell form, search the item or pick the category eBay suggests, then choose the condition that matches the task (New, Open box, Used, For parts).
Paste the title (80 characters max). Drag the photos below onto the listing in order; the first one is the gallery photo.
Fill the item specifics (brand, model, type, size, colour) from the ITEM SPECIFICS section of ebay_item.md; leave anything unknown blank.
Paste the description. Set the price as Buy It Now; turn on Best Offer when the task says offers are accepted.
Shipping or local pickup as the task says: calculated shipping with the package weight and dimensions from the task, free shipping, or local pickup only. List it.
Open the live listing, copy its URL (ebay.com/itm/...) and record it below.

fb_item._doc: Post-by-hand entry for the item ad builder. Same create form as the land facebook_marketplace entry but a regular Item for sale with a real category and condition. The worker writes <workspace>/fb_item.md with HEADLINE and DESCRIPTION sections. Location is the pickup area (metadata.pickup_area), not a property town.
manual_steps: Open the create form (Item for sale). Drag the photos below onto it in order; the first one is the cover.
Paste the title and the price (digits only). Set Category and Condition to the two values shown below the price.
Paste the description.
Set the location to the pickup area from the task so local buyers see it. Turn on shipping only when the task says the buyer pays shipping or shipping is free. Next, then Publish.
Open the published listing, copy its URL from the address bar, and record it below.

ksl._doc: Post-by-hand entry for the item ad builder. KSL Classifieds (Utah) has no public listing API and blocks headless browsers and plain HTTP clients with a 403, so the create URL and the 12-photo cap are from the site as seen in a normal browser, not confirmed by code; correct them here if the form differs. The worker writes <workspace>/ksl.md with HEADLINE and DESCRIPTION sections.
manual_steps: Open the sell form and pick the category and subcategory that fit the item.
Paste the title and the price. Set Condition to the value shown below the price; tick negotiable when the task says offers are accepted.
Paste the description. Drag the photos below onto the form in order; the first one is the main photo.
Set the location (city and zip) to the pickup area from the task, then review and post.
Open the live listing, copy its URL from the address bar, and record it below.
